title: More reliable healthy-routine reminders
summary: Fixed browser scheduling races, native cancellation, clock-change reconciliation and clearer saved-versus-draft feedback.

changes.detail: Disabling native wellness reminders now cancels pending wellness tests while preserving learning notifications; schedules are verified against OS pending requests before success.
Added UTC-offset signatures for clock-change recovery and support for existing iOS provisional notification permission.

Browser scheduling ignores disabled time fields, preserves the working schedule on invalid drafts, snapshots preferences, prevents stale permission responses from restarting reminders, and checks on focus/visibility return.
Notification settings distinguish unsaved changes and saved schedules, show saved daily reminder count, and refresh next-message preview with the journey clock.
Regression tests cover disable cancellation, provisional permission, silent OS schedule loss, invalid drafts, asynchronous opt-in races and weekday delivery.

validation.name: Automated and device validation
validation.detail: TypeScript, lint and regression tests pending. No real-device delivery or closed-app test performed; browser reminders still require an open tab. No deployment.
